evidence: The body resolves several trade/player-card property keys and routes through distinct branches that select the exact player-card actions PlayerCardNextLeftPlayer (0x7001d6dfd8), PlayerCardNextRightPlayer (0x7001d6de78), PlayerCardNextOfferPlayer (0x7001d6dc38), PlayerCardNextAskPlayer (0x7001d6e038), and their Prev variants (0x7001d6e0b8, 0x7001d6dcb8, 0x7001d6d778, 0x7001d6ddf8). It also resolves the TRADES key and formats Trade[%d].OfferedPlayer[%d].database_index and Trade[%d].AskingPlayer[%d].database_index, then dispatches the selected hit zone through f_70004d76d0 (process_player_card_hit_zone). The exact guest strings were read at these addresses from MLBTS/game/exefs/main using recomp.nso.Nso. Body: decompiled/main/main_0089.c:11865-12059. No direct callers are indexed for this stripped callback, so the name is scoped to its observed trade player-card navigation behavior. No prototype or structure fields proposed.

The function takes a state/request record, bounds-checks its 32-bit discriminator at +0x8 against seven, then routes through an eight-way jump table. The branches invoke roster/resource helpers including load_live_roster_pack and load_roster_data, and use the exact LIVE_ROSTER string at 0x7001d193d8, LIVE_ROSTERS at 0x7001ce75a6, plus roster data names such as roster_LIVE.dat, roster.dat, and roster_MTO.dat; these full addresses were resolved from MLBTS/game/exefs/main with recomp.nso.Nso and are used in the branch bodies. Indexed caller f_70009a2dc0 clears the request status at +0x0c, calls this function, and interprets its result; callers f_70009228c8 and f_7000ab2bcc also invoke it on roster/state objects (decompiled/main/main_0070.c:16875-16905; decompiled/main/main_0076.c:17280-17296; decompiled/main/main_0066.c:14184-14196). This supports a generic live-roster operation handler but not a more specific operation or record layout. Body: decompiled/main/main_0070.c:17021-18001. No prototype or fields proposed.
